description: This Java class defines a JPA entity representing a discussion post within a learning management system. It includes fields for post ID, thread ID, author ID, content, and creation timestamp, along with constructors and getter methods.

classes.name: DiscussionPost
classes.description: Entity class representing a discussion post, with properties for thread ID, author ID, content, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: DiscussionPost()
methods.description: Default constructor, protected to restrict instantiation.

methods.name: DiscussionPost(Long threadId, Long authorId, String content)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to create a new discussion post with specified thread ID, author ID, and content.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the discussion post.

methods.name: getThreadId()
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thread this post belongs to.

methods.name: getAuthorId()
methods.description: Returns the ID of the author who created the post.

methods.name: getContent()
methods.description: Returns the content of the discussion post.

methods.name: getCreatedAt()
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the post was created.
